title: ボクとみんなとカップケーキ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I find myself in possession of a helping of cupcakes, courtesy of Tazuna.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to the classroom to give one to Tokai Teio, when…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! What's up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out Tokai Teio isn't the only one still in the classroom—Mejiro McQueen, Daiwa Scarlet, and Vodka are all present as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since they're here, I decide to give them each a cupcake too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh! There's so many flavors! Which one should I pick? ♪ Choices, choices…
choice_data_list: Everyone, go ahead and help yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why, thank you. I think I'll go with the chestnut one, then.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm kind of in a strawberry mood. Thanks a bunch.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That chocolate one's got my name on it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What?! But I was gonna have that one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ah… Too bad. Ya snooze, ya lose.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heeey! These cupcakes were supposed to be for me!
choice_data_list: Why don't you fight for it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest that Teio takes half of the chocolate cupcake and half of the vanilla one that's left—two flavors for the price of one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The moment I finish explaining, Tokai Teio's eyes shine.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I get it! You're so smart, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sounds good to me. Vanilla looks pretty rad too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Me too! ♪ Okay, let's split them!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe! They both smell so good! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, sharing is caring. Hey, McQueen, wanna go halfsies, too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh. Actually… McQueen, yours looks kinda yummy too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, can I get a piece? Just a lil' bite? Please? Pleeease?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay! My goodness! But just a morsel, all right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yippee! ♪ Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hey! That was no mere morsel!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio is in a great mood after trying the cupcakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She goes to training in high spirits, and gives it all she's got.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh, yes! Let's fight for it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I was hopin' you'd say that! How're we gonna settle this?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How about a Prez Pop Quiz!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A what?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We quiz each other about Prez, and whoever gets more right answers wins!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nah, no way! I don't know the first thing about her!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If we're doin' a quiz, it should be on motorcycles!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? But I don't know the first thing about those!
choice_data_list: How about a race, to keep it fair?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second they finish speaking, the pair rush for the exit, both scrambling to be first out the door.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah… Sorry about Vodka. She can be, well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What should we do with these cupcakes? It appears those two forgot all about them.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Good luck with those two!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… I got here first!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nooo way! I was here days earlier!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a heated race, the two can't agree on who arrived first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They continue their contest across all kinds of matches, but end up making the final call with a bout of rock, paper, scissors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And sure enough, they completely forgot about the cupcakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, today's matches offered Tokai Teio some great experience.
